steps.action: Organization name, logo, locale and timezone save and survive reload
steps.actual: Name saved on Enter, Escape reverted unsaved text, uploaded SVG persisted, Asia/Dubai saved, and locale offered only en-US.

steps.action: Last Administrator demotion is refused and own archive action is absent
steps.actual: Own row had no archive action; choosing Contributor displayed last-Administrator refusal and retained Administrator.

steps.action: Invalid invitation is blocked; pending invitation can be resent and revoked
steps.actual: Malformed email failed browser validation; Contributor invite was delivered, resent with a new message, then revoked and removed from Users.

steps.action: Activate the welcome invitation and deny organization administration to its Legal Team Member
steps.actual: Emailed activation set the password; Rowan signed in as Legal Team Member, Users redirected to Profile, and direct user administration returned 403.

steps.action: Changing a role changes live account access and revoking sessions requires sign-in again
steps.actual: Rowan’s current account read became Contributor; revocation invalidated the existing session, and the still-active account could sign in again.

steps.action: Archival blocks old sessions and new sign-in; restore permits fresh sign-in only
steps.actual: Archived Rowan disappeared until Show archived, lost the old session and could not sign in; Restore preserved revocation and allowed a new Contributor session.
